_doc: Weapons (GAME_DESIGN.md: Weapons). Each of the 8 levels lists its full stats: damage, cooldown (seconds between attacks), hit_interval (how soon the same enemy can be hit again; 0 = once per attack or per projectile), range_px (targeting range), area (multiplier), knockback (push speed px/s), plus pattern values (arc_deg; count, spread_deg, speed_px_s, lift_px_s, gravity_px_s2, return_after_s, lifetime_s, radius_px, pierce). in_level_up_pool: can be offered as a new weapon on level-up. ALL NUMBERS ARE PLACEHOLDERS until the Phase 7 fun tuning. Evolved weapons (evolved_from) are swapped in by a chest when the weapon is level 8 and its paired passive is owned (GAME_DESIGN.md: Standard evolutions); they have one level at about 2x level-8 damage.
Phase 15: the signature weapons of King Arthur, Atalanta, and Odysseus, and the Sling of Lugh (secret). All numbers are placeholders.
